title: bonds channel — schema-first (AFB backend<->AFB frontend only; not part of afb.execution.v1 wire)
description: Negotiated via auth.support/auth_ok.support (capability id afbws.bonds.channel.v1). MOEX bonds: a bond search and cards, bond portfolios, upcoming offer/maturity/amortization events and market-wide price/volume anomaly signals. Same convention as afbws.screener/afbws.instrument.v2: ONE schema id per message (`afbws.bonds.<op>.v1`, no .request/.response suffixes); the same schema is the request, its response and, where documented, the server push; a message WITHOUT `request_id` is a server push; `request_id` is required in every client request. A failed request is answered with `afbws.bonds.error.v1`; a refused item of a batch goes to `rejected[]`. Operations: `search`, `bond`, `screener`, `emitter`, `rates`, `rates.set`, `portfolios`, `portfolio`, `portfolios.set`, `signals`, `events`. `screener` is the bond screener (columnar, filters are kept per connection and applied to its pushes), `emitter` lists all bonds of an issuer, `rates`/`rates.set` are the base rates (key rate, RUONIA) from which floating coupons are forecast (set by staff only). There is no copy operation: adding a bond, or the composition of somebody else's portfolio, to one's own portfolio is an edit of the own composition via `portfolios.set`. IDENTITY. A bond is identified ONLY by `instrument_key` (the same composite catalog key as any instrument: `MISX:<primary board>:<secid>`, e.g. `MISX:TQCB:RU000A10A3Z4`; case-sensitive, never normalized). `secid`, `isin` and `shortname` are plain display/search attributes (`bondRow.secid`, `position.secid`) and never an identifier in any request, response or push. A board change (e.g. TQCB -> TQRD after a default) is another key, i.e. another bond: nothing is renamed or migrated. PORTFOLIO MODEL (the model changed: the former purchase journal is replaced by the PORTFOLIO ACCOUNT). Every portfolio has a virtual account of type `bond` (`account_id = "bond:" + portfolio_id`, `portfolioRef.account_id`; see afbws.account.channel.v2): the user sets the quantities, the backend emulates buys/sells at LAST MOEX, keeps money per currency and credits payments by schedule; the analytics of `portfolio` is built from the account. The journal operation `trades.set` is removed; `trades=[]`, `series.rows=[]`, `totals.xirr=null` in `portfolio` are kept for compatibility. The text below about purchases (journal) describes the legacy model. A portfolio is a set (type `bond`) with a COMPOSITION: `instrument_keys[]` — bonds only, in display order, at most 200. A PUBLIC (reference) portfolio is created and edited by staff only (`visibility` guest|user|manager) and is pure structure: it has no purchases. PURCHASES (the trade journal: date, price, quantity) exist only in PERSONAL portfolios and are an attribute of a bond that is in the composition; a bond may be in the composition with no purchases (observation). Removing a bond from a personal portfolio deletes its purchases there. A personal portfolio can be created by anybody with the `bonds` capability; a public visibility needs staff (`forbidden`); the scope personal <-> public never changes (`validation_error`); a `category=default` bond cannot be in a public portfolio. The bond search is paged by `offset` / `limit` (at most 100 per page); there is no cursor. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, numbers are JSON numbers, never NaN (a missing value is null). Money is in the bond face-value currency (`faceunit`), next to it a `_rub` field in rubles. Yields are computed without personal income tax and commissions. Access requires the `bonds` capability; otherwise `forbidden`; while the backend has the channel disabled it answers `unsupported_action`. Bond portfolios are sets of type `bond` in the catalog; they never appear in afbws.instrument.channel.v2 `sets` or afbws.catalog.channel.v1 snapshots. Reconciliation with the broker account (`reconcile`) is added later, additively, and is gated by the same capability `bonds`. See AFB/docs/ws/bonds.md.

secid.description: MOEX ISS bond code (SECID): a DISPLAY and search attribute only, never an identifier (the identifier is `instrument_key`). Case-sensitive, never normalized (.lower()/.upper()).

category.description: Bond category: `ofz` federal government, `subfederal` regions, `municipal` municipalities, `corporate`, `currency` (currency-denominated), `default` — issuers in (technical) default. Replacement bonds are not a separate category.

visibility.description: Who sees a portfolio; same semantics as afbws.instrument.channel.v2 visibility. `personal` — only its owner (any user with the `bonds` capability may create these). `guest`/`user`/`manager` — a PUBLIC (reference) portfolio visible to callers whose tier is at least that one; creating, changing or deleting a public portfolio and editing its journal is manager-only (`forbidden` otherwise).

favoriteColor.description: Same list and order as afbws.instrument.channel.v2 favoriteColor (kept in lockstep; no cross-reference on purpose).

faceunit.description: Currency of the bond face value (ISS FACEUNIT, e.g. `SUR`, `USD`, `CNY`). All money fields without the `_rub` suffix are in this currency; fields with `_rub` are the same amount converted to rubles.

flag.description: Data-quality marker explaining an assumption behind a figure. `float_assumed` — a future coupon is taken equal to the last known one (floater); `float_projected` — a future floater coupon is a FORECAST from the base rate set by a manager (`rates`) plus the spread (such payments carry `projected`); `indexed_nominal` — a future face value of an inflation-indexed OFZ is taken equal to the current one; `no_fx` — no FX rate, `_rub` figures are missing; `no_market` — no market data, valued by the last known price; `default` — the issuer is in default; `matured` — the bond is already redeemed. `no_trades` — the bond is in the portfolio composition but has no purchases (purchase-based figures are null).

market.description: Market block of a bond. The whole block is null outside trading and when there is no data.

price_pct.description: Last (or close) price in percent of face value.

yield.description: Yield to maturity or to offer, percent per year.

ytm_kind.description: What `yield` is: `ytm` to maturity, `yto` to the nearest offer; null when there is no yield.

accint.description: Accrued coupon interest per bond, in `faceunit`.

updated_at.description: Moment of the quote (ISO 8601 with zone).

marketOrNull.description: `market` block, or null outside trading / without data.

bondRow.description: One bond in a search result list, a portfolio tile or a favorites plaque. `coupon_kind`/`coupon_spread_pct` let the plaque draw the coupon label (`7.10%`, `key rate`, `key rate + 3.5%`, `RUONIA`) without requesting the card; the base code `coupon_benchmark` is deliberately not in the row (the label follows from `coupon_kind`). The `bond` card repeats every field of this row.

instrument_key.description: Bond identifier: the composite instrument key `MISX:<primary board>:<secid>` (e.g. `MISX:TQCB:RU000A10A3Z4`), the ONLY way to identify a bond. Case-sensitive, never normalized. A board change is another key, i.e. another bond.

name.description: Full bond name (issue title) as given by ISS; null when unknown. Shown in the list plaque; search by ISIN stays a server-side filter (`query`) and does not add it to the row.

facevalue.description: Current face value in `faceunit` (for inflation-indexed OFZ — the daily indexed value).

matdate.description: Maturity date; null for perpetual bonds.

offerdate.description: Nearest future offer date; null when none.

coupon_percent.description: Current annual coupon rate, percent of face value; null when unknown.

coupon_frequency.description: Coupon payments per year; null when unknown.

coupon_kind.description: Coupon type from the bond passport; `unknown` when the bond has no passport yet.

coupon_spread_pct.description: Spread over the floating base, percentage points; null for fixed coupons, without a passport or without a spread.

is_qualified.description: True when only qualified investors may buy the bond.

lifecycle.description: `active` — traded or awaiting redemption; `matured` — redeemed (returned only with `include_matured`).

bond.description: A bond card: the search row plus lot attributes and the passport (coupon type, redemption kind, amortization, issue, liquidity, issuer).

instrument_key.description: Bond identifier: the composite instrument key `MISX:<primary board>:<secid>` (e.g. `MISX:TQCB:RU000A10A3Z4`), the ONLY way to identify a bond. Case-sensitive, never normalized. A board change is another key, i.e. another bond.

isin.description: ISIN; null when ISS has none.

facevalue.description: Current face value in `faceunit` (for inflation-indexed OFZ — the daily indexed value).

matdate.description: Maturity date; null for perpetual bonds.

offerdate.description: Nearest future offer date; null when none.

coupon_percent.description: Current annual coupon rate, percent of face value; null when unknown.

coupon_frequency.description: Coupon payments per year; null when unknown.

is_qualified.description: True when only qualified investors may buy the bond.

lifecycle.description: `active` — traded or awaiting redemption; `matured` — redeemed (returned only with `include_matured`).

name.description: Full bond name (issue title) as given by ISS; null when unknown.

bond_type.description: ISS bond type as is (SECTYPE/BONDTYPE text), for display.

lot_value.description: Lot value in `faceunit` (lot size times face value) — the minimum purchase amount.

coupon_benchmark.description: Base of a floating coupon as in the source (`RREFKEYR`, `RUONIA`...), also the code in `rates`; null for fixed coupons.

coupon_spread_pct.description: Spread over the base, percentage points; null when none. The card shows e.g. `key rate + 2.5`.

call_date.description: Nearest future issuer call date; null when none.

has_amortization.description: True when a future partial amortization is scheduled.

next_amort_date.description: Nearest future partial amortization date; null when none.

issue_size.description: Issue size, pieces; null when unknown.

list_level.description: Exchange listing level; null when unknown.

liquidity_class.description: Exchange liquidity class: 0 low, 1 medium, 2 high; null when unknown.

high_risk.description: The exchange marks the bond as high-risk.

is_collateral.description: The bond is on the exchange collateral (lombard) list.

current_yield.description: Current yield: annual coupon / (clean price + accrued interest), percent; null when there is no price or coupon. The same figure as in the screener and the portfolio position.

liquidity.description: Liquidity over the last trading days; null while the liquidity data is not calculated.

rating_changed_at.description: When our collection last saw the rating group change (badge `rating changed`); null — never.

emitter.description: The issuer; null when the bond has none in the reference.

passport_at.description: UTC time of the passport collection step that filled the fields above; null — never (freshness of the card).

schedule_scan_at.description: UTC time of the market-wide schedule scan (amortization, offers); null — never.

coupon.description: One coupon of the bond schedule.

record_date.description: Record date: a holder on this date receives the payment.

value_pct.description: Coupon rate for the period, percent of the face value.

facevalue.description: Face value the coupon is calculated from (current, indexed for OFZ-IN).

projected.description: True when `value`/`value_pct` is a forecast of a floating coupon: base rate set by a manager (`rates`) plus spread. False for announced coupons and for the 'last known' assumption.

amortization.description: One amortization (partial repayment of the face value).

value_pct.description: Repaid part, percent of the initial face value.

offer.description: One offer of the bond schedule.

window_start.description: Start of the window for submitting the offer application.

window_end.description: End of the window for submitting the offer application.

price_pct.description: Offer price, percent of face value.

kind.description: Offer type as given by ISS (put/call etc.), for display.

schedule.description: Payment schedule of the bond (ISS bondization).

coupons.description: All known coupons, past and future, by date.

history.description: Daily history of the bond (columnar, like afbws.market.series.v1 tables), oldest first. `close` — percent of face value; `yield_close` — percent per year; `facevalue` — face value of the day in `faceunit`; `volume` — pieces.

columns.description: Fixed column order: date, close, yield_close, facevalue, volume.

rows.description: Each row has the same length and order as `columns`; a missing value is null (never NaN).

portfolioRef.description: A portfolio in a list: attributes and composition. No analytics.

owner.description: Owner of the portfolio. An EMPTY object `{}` means the portfolio is the caller's own (personal, or public of any visibility created by the caller). For a public portfolio of somebody else (read-only for the caller; its composition can be added to one's own portfolio via `portfolios.set`) `name` and `tier` describe the owner; `null` means the owner is unknown.

name.description: Display name of the owner; null — unknown. Absent for the caller's own portfolio.

tier.description: Tier of the owner (e.g. `admin`, `manager`); null — unknown. Absent for the caller's own portfolio.

instrument_keys.description: Composition: the instrument keys of the bonds of the portfolio in display order (at most 200, no duplicates). Empty for a new portfolio.

account_id.description: Id of the portfolio's virtual account (type `bond`, `bond:<portfolio id>`, see afbws.account.channel.v2); null for a public portfolio created before the account was introduced, until staff makes the first record. Not in `required`: older payloads without the field stay valid.

id.description: Portfolio id; unknown id creates the portfolio.

visibility.description: Omitted: `personal` on create, unchanged on update. A public visibility is staff-only (`forbidden`). The scope personal <-> public cannot change (`validation_error`).

instrument_keys.description: The WHOLE composition (instrument keys) in final order (omit the list to leave the composition untouched). Every key must exist in the bond directory; duplicates are dropped by the backend; more than 200 bonds are refused (`maxItems` here; the backend enforces its own limit constant with `validation_error`); a public portfolio cannot contain a `category=default` bond. Bonds removed from the composition lose their purchases in this portfolio.

trade_id.description: Journal entry id (client-generated on create); a known id updates the entry.

instrument_key.description: Bond identifier: the composite instrument key `MISX:<primary board>:<secid>` (e.g. `MISX:TQCB:RU000A10A3Z4`), the ONLY way to identify a bond. Case-sensitive, never normalized. A board change is another key, i.e. another bond.

trade_date.description: Trade date; not later than today and not earlier than the bond's issue date.

quantity.description: Pieces: positive — purchase, negative — sale. A sale cannot exceed the balance on the date.

accrued_int.description: Accrued coupon interest per bond, in `faceunit`. Omitted: taken from the daily data of the date (ISS ACCINT).

commission.description: Commission of the trade, in `faceunit`; part of the invested amount only, never affects yields.

value.description: Next coupon amount per position (quantity applied), in `faceunit`.

eventKind.description: Event kind: `offer` buyback offer, `maturity` redemption, `amortization` partial repayment, `call` issuer's call option.

position.description: One row per bond of the portfolio. Fields that depend on purchases (`quantity`, `avg_price_pct`, `invested`, `market_value`, `market_value_rub`, `ytm_purchase`, `received`) are null for a bond without purchases (flag `no_trades`).

instrument_key.description: Bond identifier: the composite instrument key `MISX:<primary board>:<secid>` (e.g. `MISX:TQCB:RU000A10A3Z4`), the ONLY way to identify a bond. Case-sensitive, never normalized. A board change is another key, i.e. another bond.

quantity.description: Balance, pieces; null for a bond without purchases.

avg_price_pct.description: Average purchase price, percent of face value; null without purchases.

invested.description: Sum of purchases including accrued interest and commission minus sales, in `faceunit`; null without purchases.

price_pct.description: Current price, percent of face value.

market_value.description: Market value of the position in `faceunit`; null without purchases or market data.

market_value_rub.description: Market value of the position in rubles; null without purchases, market data or FX rate.

current_yield.description: Annual coupon / (price + accrued interest), percent at the market price; does not depend on purchases (filled for a bond without purchases too); null only if undefined (no price or no coupon).

ytm_market.description: Yield at the market price, percent per year.

ytm_kind.description: What `ytm_market` is: to maturity or to offer; null without yield.

ytm_purchase.description: XIRR of the purchases and future payments, percent per year; null without purchases.

received.description: Payments received so far; null without purchases.

flags.description: Assumptions behind the figures of this position.

payment.description: A past or future payment of a position.

instrument_key.description: Bond identifier: the composite instrument key `MISX:<primary board>:<secid>` (e.g. `MISX:TQCB:RU000A10A3Z4`), the ONLY way to identify a bond. Case-sensitive, never normalized. A board change is another key, i.e. another bond.

amount_rub.description: Amount in rubles; null without FX rate.

status.description: `received` — the bond was on the balance on the record date and the date has passed; `expected` — future.

assumed.description: True when the amount is an assumption (see position flags `float_assumed`, `indexed_nominal`).

projected.description: True when the amount is a forecast from the base rate (flag `float_projected`); such a payment is also `assumed`.

series.description: Daily series of the portfolio from the date of the first trade (columnar). `market_value_rub`, `invested_rub`, `received_rub` — rubles; `ytm` — percent per year.

columns.description: Fixed column order: date, market_value_rub, invested_rub, received_rub, ytm.

rows.description: Each row has the same length and order as `columns`; a missing value is null (never NaN).

totals.description: Portfolio totals; each figure is null when it cannot be computed.

current_yield.description: Market-value-weighted current yield of the held positions, percent per year (coupon over clean price); null when it cannot be computed.

annual_coupons_rub.description: Annual coupon income at the current balance, rubles.

portfolioRejection.description: A refused portfolio of `portfolios.set` (`forbidden`, `validation_error`, `not_found`). `reason` (optional, refines `code`): `no_last_price` / `no_fx` — the removal of a bond from the composition is refused because the auto-sale of the position at LAST MOEX is impossible (no known LAST / no exchange rate for the conversion). The deletion of a portfolio is unconditional: positions are not sold and prices are not needed.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason, optional. no_last_price: no known LAST MOEX (the last known one, not necessarily of today) for a position being auto-sold; no_fx: no exchange rate for the conversion. Open for additive extension.

severity.description: Signal strength; a signal that becomes stronger is pushed again.

rule.description: Anomaly rule code (price drop, volume spike, yield jump, G-spread jump, price below face, decline streak); an open set defined by the backend.

metrics.description: Values that triggered the rule (observed value, threshold, baseline); keys depend on the rule.

signal.description: A market-wide price/volume anomaly of one bond.

instrument_key.description: Bond identifier: the composite instrument key `MISX:<primary board>:<secid>` (e.g. `MISX:TQCB:RU000A10A3Z4`), the ONLY way to identify a bond. Case-sensitive, never normalized. A board change is another key, i.e. another bond.

held.description: True when the caller holds the bond in any of their portfolios.

event.description: An upcoming event of a bond held in the caller's portfolios, within the `notice_days` horizon.

instrument_key.description: Bond identifier: the composite instrument key `MISX:<primary board>:<secid>` (e.g. `MISX:TQCB:RU000A10A3Z4`), the ONLY way to identify a bond. Case-sensitive, never normalized. A board change is another key, i.e. another bond.

portfolio_ids.description: The caller's portfolios holding the bond.

window_start.description: Start of the offer application window (offer only).

window_end.description: End of the offer application window (offer only).

amount.description: Amount of the event in `faceunit` for the held quantity.

amount_rub.description: The same in rubles; null without FX rate.

search.title: afbws.bonds.search.v1 — bond search (request / response).
search.description: Request: optional filters; `query` matches the SECID code (a search attribute, not an identifier), ISIN, short name or name (case-insensitive, at least 2 characters); `categories` / `faceunits` filter by the listed values; `mat_from` / `mat_to` bound the maturity date inclusively; `include_default` (default false) adds `category=default` bonds; `include_matured` (default false) adds redeemed bonds; `sort`: `name` (default), `matdate`, `yield`, with direction `sort_direction` `asc` (default) / `desc`; the order is fully deterministic (see `sort`); `limit` (1..100, default 50) and `offset` (default 0): a window of `limit` rows starting at `offset` of the filtered, sorted list. Response: `total` (rows in the whole filtered list), `offset` (echo of the requested offset), `items[]` (<=100); an offset past the end gives empty `items` and the correct `total`.

sort.description: Request. Sort key of the list (default `name`). `name`: the bond name (`name`, or `shortname` when `name` is null), compared case-insensitively with correct Cyrillic ordering; `matdate`: maturity date; `yield`: yield from the market snapshot (fallback: last daily yield). Rows without a value (null `matdate` / `yield`) are always last, in both directions. The secondary key is always the bond's `secid` code ascending, then `instrument_key` (in both directions), so the order is strictly deterministic: consecutive windows of the same request never overlap or skip rows.

sort_direction.description: Request. Direction of `sort` (default `asc`). Does not affect the placement of rows without a value (always last) or the `secid`/`instrument_key` tiebreak (always ascending).

offset.description: Index of the first requested row in the filtered list (0-based, default 0); echoed in the response. The client asks for the window that contains the page it shows; there is no cursor.

total.description: Response only. Number of rows in the whole filtered list.

bondMsg.title: afbws.bonds.bond.v1 — one bond card (request / response).
bondMsg.description: Request: `instrument_key`. Response: the bond (the card carries `instrument_key` and the display `secid`), its payment `schedule` and the daily `history` (columnar). Unknown key — error `not_found`. Coupons of the schedule have `projected`: true when the amount is a FORECAST from the base rate (see `rates`).

instrument_key.description: Bond identifier: the composite instrument key `MISX:<primary board>:<secid>` (e.g. `MISX:TQCB:RU000A10A3Z4`), the ONLY way to identify a bond. Case-sensitive, never normalized. A board change is another key, i.e. another bond.

portfolios.title: afbws.bonds.portfolios.v1 — portfolio list with the bonds of their compositions (request / response / push).
portfolios.description: Request is an empty command. Response and push carry `portfolios` — the caller's own portfolios first, then the public ones visible to their tier, each with its composition `instrument_keys[]` — and `bonds`: the rows of the bonds of ALL listed compositions, without duplicates (same `bondRow` as in `search`, with `market`), so that the client draws the bond tiles without extra requests — and `totals`: the portfolio totals (see the property) for the portfolios with an account. No payment list and no per-position analytics is computed for the list. Server push: the same body WITHOUT `request_id` whenever the STRUCTURE changes (a portfolio is created, deleted, renamed, its visibility, composition or order changes) and whenever the totals change (a market snapshot, an account operation) — to the other connections of the owner for a personal portfolio, to every connection with the `bonds` capability that requested the list for a public one; each recipient gets its own list by its tier.
Response and push. Own and visible public portfolios.

bonds.description: Response and push. Bond rows of all compositions of `portfolios`, without duplicates.

totals.description: Response and push. Totals of the portfolios with an account, keyed by portfolio id (the same ids as in `portfolios`): invested amount, market value, payments received, weighted yields, duration, annual coupons. A portfolio without an account, without read access or without held positions has no key (the client shows no figures). No payment list is computed.

portfolio.title: afbws.bonds.portfolio.v1 — one portfolio with the journal and analytics (request / response / push).
portfolio.description: Request: `id`. Response: the portfolio (`portfolioRef` with its composition) with analytics. A portfolio with a virtual account (`portfolio.account_id`, type `bond`, afbws.account.channel.v2) is filled from the account: `positions[]` (`quantity`, `avg_price_pct`, `invested`, `received`), `payments[]` (`received` from the account log plus `expected` for the current quantity), `totals`, `calendar`, `breakdown`. Compatibility fields, kept so older frontends do not break: `trades` is always `[]` (the journal is replaced by the account log, afbws.account.ledger.v2), `series.rows` is `[]`, `totals.xirr` is null. A public portfolio is read-only. Server push: the same body WITHOUT `request_id` once per market snapshot and after each account change (cash, set, income credit) or composition edit — to the connections that requested this id last. Unknown or foreign personal id — error `not_found`.

payments.description: Response only. Past and future payments of the positions.

flags.description: Response only. Assumptions behind the portfolio totals.

calendar.description: Response only. Expected payments grouped by month, ascending (the grouping of `payments[]` with status `expected`).

portfoliosSet.title: afbws.bonds.portfolios.set.v1 — create / change / reorder / delete portfolios and their compositions (request / response).
portfoliosSet.description: Request: `portfolios[]` — upsert by `id` (an unknown id creates), each with its WHOLE composition `instrument_keys[]` in final order (omit `instrument_keys` to leave a composition untouched); the order of `portfolios[]` is the display order (personal ones and public ones are ordered separately); `remove[]` — ids to delete (their purchases go with them); at least one of `portfolios`/`remove`. Rules: a personal portfolio — for everybody with the `bonds` capability; a public visibility — staff only (`forbidden`); the scope personal <-> public cannot change (`validation_error`); a foreign personal portfolio is `not_found`; an id taken by a set of another type is `validation_error`. Composition: every instrument key must exist (otherwise `validation_error`, the unknown ones are listed in the message), duplicates are dropped, at most 200 bonds (`maxItems`; the backend constant gives `validation_error`), a public portfolio cannot contain a `category=default` bond; bonds removed from the composition of a personal portfolio lose their purchases there. A refused item goes to `rejected[]`, the others are applied. Response: the caller's whole current list in `portfolios` (with `instrument_keys`), the bond rows of all compositions in `bonds` (as in `portfolios`) and the refused items in `rejected` (empty when all applied). Other connections receive the changed structure as a `portfolios` push.

portfolios.description: Request: upserts (`portfolioEdit`). Response: the resulting list (`portfolioRef`), in display order.

remove.description: Request. Ids of portfolios to delete.

bonds.description: Response only. Bond rows of all compositions of `portfolios`, without duplicates.

totals.description: Response only. Totals of the portfolios of the resulting list, as in `portfolios`.

signals.title: afbws.bonds.signals.v1 — market anomaly feed (request / response / push).
signals.description: Request: `days` (1..30, default 5) — how far back, `held_only` (default false) — only the caller's bonds. Response: `items`. Server push: new and strengthened signals WITHOUT `request_id` to the connections that requested the feed.

held_only.description: Request. Only bonds held by the caller (default false).

events.title: afbws.bonds.events.v1 — upcoming events of the caller's bonds (request / response / push).
events.description: Request is an empty command. Response: `items` — events of the caller's portfolios within the `notice_days` horizon of their settings. Server push: the same body WITHOUT `request_id` at the daily step.

error.title: afbws.bonds.error.v1 — typed error for a whole request (server -> client).

couponKind.description: Coupon type of a bond (bond passport). `fixed` — fixed rate; `fixed_unknown` — fixed, but future coupons are not announced yet; `key_rate` — floater on the CBR key rate (+ spread); `ruonia` — floater on RUONIA (+ spread); `cpi` — inflation-linked; `other_float` — another floating coupon; `zero` — zero coupon; `unknown` — not determined. Read by the screener (filter, column, bubble colour), the bond card and the portfolio structure; `key_rate`/`ruonia` are the kinds a coupon forecast is built for.

redemptionKind.description: How the issue ends (ISS BONDSUBTYPE): `maturity` — redemption at the maturity date; `put` — with a holder put offer; `call` — with an issuer call option; `perpetual` — no maturity. Read by the screener and the bond card.

ratingGroup.description: Rating group of the ISSUER as given by the exchange (no agency, scale or outlook), best first: AAA ... D. An issuer without a rating has `null` where the field is nullable.

range.description: Numeric range filter; both bounds inclusive, each optional. A value of a bond that is null does not pass a range with any bound set.

screenerFilters.description: Screener filters; every field is optional, an absent field does not filter. By default the screener is for a non-qualified investor: qualified-only, defaulted and high-risk bonds are excluded unless the matching `include_*` is true. A redeemed bond never gets into the screener. The server keeps ONE set of filters per connection (the last `screener` request) and applies it to the pushes.

query.description: Case-insensitive text search over secid, ISIN, bond name, issuer name and issuer INN; at least 2 characters.

categories.description: Multi-select by category; empty or absent — all.

faceunits.description: Multi-select by face value currency; empty or absent — all.

coupon_kinds.description: Multi-select by coupon type; empty or absent — all.

rating_min.description: Issuer rating group not lower than this one.

include_unrated.description: Used together with `rating_min`: whether bonds of unrated issuers pass. Default true.

years_to_event.description: Years to the nearest event (maturity, put or call offer).

amortization.description: `with` — only bonds with a future amortization, `without` — only without; default `any`.

offer.description: `with` — only bonds with a future put/call offer, `without` — only without; default `any`.

liquidity_classes.description: Exchange liquidity classes (0 low, 1 medium, 2 high); empty or absent — all.

min_value_avg.description: Minimum average daily turnover, rubles, over `liquidity_days`.

min_numtrades_avg.description: Minimum average daily number of trades over `liquidity_days`.

emitter_id.description: Only the bonds of this issuer.

include_qualified.description: Include bonds for qualified investors only. Default false.

include_default.description: Include bonds of defaulted issuers. Default false.

include_high_risk.description: Include bonds the exchange marks as high-risk. Default false.

screenerEmitter.description: Issuer entry of the `emitters` dictionary of a screener response.

screenerColumns.description: Column names of `rows`, ALWAYS exactly this list in exactly this order (the order is part of the contract; a column is added only by a new schema version): instrument_key, secid, shortname, category, faceunit, coupon_kind, coupon_percent, coupon_benchmark, coupon_spread_pct, coupon_frequency, matdate, offerdate, call_date, redemption_kind, has_amortization, next_amort_date, is_qualified, high_risk, liquidity_class, list_level, emitter_id, price_pct, ytm, ytm_kind, current_yield, duration_days, accint, value_avg, numtrades_avg, value_today, years_to_event. Shared by `screener` and `emitter`.

screenerRow.description: One bond: values in the order of `columns`. Market columns (`price_pct`, `ytm`, `ytm_kind`, `current_yield`, `duration_days`, `accint`, `value_today`) are null without a quote; `value_avg`/`numtrades_avg` are null while the liquidity store is empty; the issuer rating of the row is taken from the `emitters` dictionary by `emitter_id`. `years_to_event` — years to the nearest maturity/put/call, null for a perpetual bond with no event.

screener.title: afbws.bonds.screener.v1 — bond screener (request / response / push).
screener.description: Request: optional `filters` (`screenerFilters`); the server stores them as THE filters of this connection (replacing the previous ones, an absent `filters` means no filters) and answers at once. Response: the whole filtered set without pages, columnar: `asof` (time of the market snapshot the rows are built from, null before the first snapshot), `liquidity_days` (window of `value_avg`/`numtrades_avg`), `total` (= number of rows), `emitters` (dictionary issuer id -> {title, rating_group}, only the issuers present in the rows; JSON keys are strings), `columns` and `rows`. Sorting is the client's job. Server push: the same body WITHOUT `request_id` after every market snapshot (about every 5 minutes) to the connections whose last state is an open screener, built by their stored filters. A filter the schema allows but the backend refuses (e.g. `min` > `max`) — error `validation_error`. Needs the `bonds` capability.

asof.description: Response and push. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or time (ISO 8601) of the market snapshot the rows are built from; null before the first snapshot.

liquidity_days.description: Response and push. Length in trading days of the window behind `value_avg` and `numtrades_avg`.

total.description: Response and push. Number of rows.

emitters.description: Response and push. Issuers of the rows by issuer id (a string key); the rating of a row is read here by its `emitter_id`.

rows.description: Response and push. Bonds in the order of the reference.

emitterCard.description: An issuer with the size of its debt.

bonds_count.description: Number of the issuer's active bonds (= rows of the response).

outstanding_rub.description: Outstanding debt in rubles: sum of issue size times face value over the active bonds, currency bonds converted at the current rate. Null when it cannot be computed (a bond without issue size or without an FX rate).

emitter.title: afbws.bonds.emitter.v1 — an issuer and all its active bonds (request / response).
emitter.description: Rotation by issuer. Request: `emitter_id`. Response: the issuer (`emitterCard`) and ALL its active bonds, qualified-only ones included (the `is_qualified` column tells them), without filters, in the `columns`/`rows` format of `screener`. Comparing with the bond the user came from is done by the client on the rows already received. Unknown issuer — error `not_found`. Needs the `bonds` capability.

emitter_id.description: Request. Issuer id; the response echoes it.

rateItem.description: A base rate for the forecast of floating coupons.

code.description: Base code = the bond's `coupon_benchmark` (e.g. `RREFKEYR` key rate, `RUONIA`). Case-sensitive.

title.description: Name for the manager's form and the bond card.

value_pct.description: Rate, percent per year (0..100); null — not set, no forecast is built for the bonds of this base.

updated_at.description: When the rate was last set (ISO 8601); null — never.

code.description: Base code (an existing one; an unknown code goes to `rejected`).

value_pct.description: New rate, percent per year (0..100); null clears it.

code.description: Code of the refused item as sent.

reason.description: `unknown_code` — no such base; `invalid_value` — not a number in 0..100 (or null).

rates.title: afbws.bonds.rates.v1 — base rates of floating coupons (request / response / push).
rates.description: Request is an empty command. Response and push: `items` — every base with its current rate. Read by everyone with the `bonds` capability (the bond card shows which rate a forecast is built with). Server push: the same body WITHOUT `request_id` to every connection with `bonds` after `rates.set` changed a rate.

ratesSet.title: afbws.bonds.rates.set.v1 — set base rates (request / response).
ratesSet.description: Staff only (manager or admin); anybody else gets `forbidden`. Request: `items[{code, value_pct}]`; `value_pct` null clears a rate. An unknown `code` or an invalid value goes to `rejected[]`, the others are applied. Response: the current state of ALL bases in `items` (as in `rates`) and `rejected` (empty when all applied). After a write the server pushes `rates` to every connection with `bonds` and recomputes the `portfolio` pushes of the open portfolios (a forecast coupon changes).

breakdownItem.description: One group of a portfolio structure.

key.description: Group key: category / coupon kind / currency / rating group (`none` — unrated) / maturity bucket (`<1`, `1-3`, `3-5`, `>5`, `none`) / issuer id (`other` — the rest after the top 10, `none` — unknown).

label.description: Display name when the key is not self-explanatory (issuer name, bucket, 'No rating'). Absent — show the key.

market_value_rub.description: Market value of the group in rubles (with accrued interest).

share.description: Share of the group in the valued part of the portfolio, 0..1; shares of one grouping sum to 1.

ytm.description: Market-value-weighted yield of the group, percent per year; null when none can be computed.

positions.description: Number of held positions in the group.

breakdown.description: Structure of the portfolio over held positions that have a ruble market value (positions without one are not counted in any group). Shares are of market value in rubles. Empty arrays for a portfolio with no valued positions.

by_currency.description: By face value currency, largest first.

by_rating.description: By issuer rating group AAA..D, then `none` (unrated).

by_maturity.description: By years to the nearest event (maturity or put offer): `<1`, `1-3`, `3-5`, `>5`, `none`.

by_emitter.description: By issuer: the top 10 largest, then `other`.

calendarMonth.description: Expected payments of one month, in rubles; a sum is null when some payment of the month has no FX rate. Forecast and assumed amounts are included (they are marked in `payments[]`).

items_count.description: Number of payments in the month.
